I have been using this air fryer for about a month now and I honestly cannot believe how much I use it. Chips come out crispy with almost no oil, chicken wings are juicy inside, and cleaning takes two minutes because the basket is non stick. It heats up fast, the timer is accurate and it is barely louder than a fan. My family now asks for it every evening. Worth every rupee and I would happily buy it again as a gift.

Booked this hotel for a three night family trip based on the photos and reviews, and it was a disaster from start to finish. Check in took over an hour because they had lost our reservation, the room smelled of damp, the air conditioning leaked onto the bed and the bathroom door would not lock. When we complained at the front desk the manager just shrugged and said nothing could be done. We left a day early and are still waiting for a refund.
